metadata.case_name: SHEK KAM CHING v. PO KEE CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING LTD. AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: steel bender; essentially a factory worker

injuries.description: small prolapsed intervertebral disc at L5/S1 level
source: He suffered a small prolapsed intervertebral disc at L5/S1 level.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: Persistent pain at his lower back
Decreased job-related strength and tolerance in maintaining a particular work posture
Limited range of movement of the spine
Tenderness over the lower end of the right paraspinal muscle
Unable to return to his pre-injury work
Difficulties in maintaining a particular work posture for a long duration or to exert force with working

treatments_received: treatment at Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital on 11 January 2002

losses.description: Unable to return to his pre-injury work; decreased job-related strength and tolerance in maintaining a particular work posture.
